text:
alex: Heads up — release/1.14.2 went out ~30m ago. I'm seeing a jump in small-batch P99 (~12-18%) for text-generation requests. Anyone else seeing this?

mira: yep, got the same alert. perf-ci posted a failed benchmark for the night build. Investigating.

perf-ci: nightly/perf-suite failed: job=perf/small-batch-p99, baseline=48ms, current=57ms (+18%). link: https://ci.internal/perf/8732

sam: I started a quick git bisect against the release branch. Suspect recent kernel-selector heuristics + kv-cache TTL change landed together.

alex: timeline — both patches merged within ~10 mins of each other: 2f9c8d3 (kv: ttl default=30s) and a8b4f1e (kernel selector: prefer-int8 for short sequences). Could be interplay.

mira: can you run a targeted perf job that toggles each change? small-batch P99 is sensitive to kernel dispatch overhead.

sam: doing that now. Running two builds: (1) revert kernel selector commit, (2) revert kv-ttl commit.

sam: results: reverting kernel selector returns p99 to ~49ms. reverting kv-ttl stays at ~56ms. So root cause looks like a8b4f1e.

alex: good catch. We need a hotfix branch and backport the revert. Can someone cut hotfix/1.14.2-perf and cherry-pick the revert?

mira: I'll create the branch and open the PR. Steps I'll run:

```bash
# create hotfix branch
git checkout -b hotfix/1.14.2-perf release/1.14.2
# revert the bad commit on top (using the original commit sha)
git revert --no-edit a8b4f1e
# push and open PR to release branch
git push origin hotfix/1.14.2-perf
```

mira: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/592 (revert kernel-selector change). Marking as release-blocker.

deploy-bot: build triggered for hotfix/1.14.2-perf -> build #5421. Status: running.

tess: quick question — is this safe to cherry-pick to dedicated and private channels too? Kernel selector affects all runtimes.

alex: yes, we should backport to dedicated and private. Patch should be minimal (just the revert). We'll cut cherry-picks after verification on canary.

sam: build #5421 finished. Ran perf suite on canary. small-batch p99 = 50ms (within noise). CI perf check: PASS.

perf-ci: perf check success for hotfix build #5421: small-batch-p99 delta = +2% (within threshold).

mira: merging hotfix PR now and creating cherry-pick for release/1.14.x and master.

mira: cherry-pick commands I used:

```bash
# onto release/1.14.x
git checkout release/1.14.x
git cherry-pick -x <hotfix-commit-sha>
# onto master
 git checkout master
git cherry-pick -x <hotfix-commit-sha>
```

jun: deployed hotfix to canary pool. Running additional KV-heavy and KV-light scenarios to ensure no regressions in cache behavior.

tess: I ran profiler on canary with new hotfix. Snap of relevant section: 

```
-- before (a8b4f1e) --
dispatch_kernel_overhead_ms: 1.9
attn_short_seq_kernel_ms: 12.4
p99_small_batch_total_ms: 57.2

-- after (hotfix) --
dispatch_kernel_overhead_ms: 0.8
attn_short_seq_kernel_ms: 8.9
p99_small_batch_total_ms: 50.1
```

alex: looks good. Lower dispatch overhead suggests the selector added a mis-optimized kernel path for short sequences. We'll need a follow-up to rework selector heuristics and add a test to CI to catch this class.

mira: filing follow-up ticket: PERF-4722 (rework kernel selector heuristics + add unit/integration perf test). Assigning to sam and tess.

sam: note for release notes: hotfix fixes small-batch latency regression introduced by kernel-selector change. No user-visible API change.

mira: marking incident resolved. Rolling the hotfix to production in 30m if canary stays green.

deploy-bot: hotfix promoted to prod: deploy #5421 -> success.

alex: thanks everyone. Postmortem: we missed a targeted perf test in PR that would have caught the dispatch overhead. Let's add that to the PR checklist.

jun: +1 on checklist. Also will add a CI micro-benchmark that runs short-seq kernel perf on submit.

mira: closing thread — will update PERF-4722 with artifacts and profiler traces. :thumbsup:
